mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE above 8.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in manufacturing production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) indicate a deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST above 580 thousand units with monthly growth exceeding 0.5%) signal strengthening residential demand, which supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 580 and MoM growth exceeds 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Increasing retail sales (RSAFS above 320 billion dollars) reflect robust consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 320 billion (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) indicate a stagflationary environment where monetary policy is ineffective, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 90) signals weakening industrial activity, which reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
